policy: Newest first. Conference papers stay together by edition and use the event start date. Journals use verified first-online dates; missing dates fall back to supplied publication dates or citation year. DOI creation, indexing and acceptance dates are never treated as online publication dates. Partial dates retain their real precision. Citation text and homepage selection are unchanged.
